model_note: shared_two has source-specific amplitudes and common E0 and excited-state gap; it is an explicit two-level approximation.
covariance: Full covariance across sources and selected times; no eigenmode cut, shrinkage, or diagonal approximation; largest dimension 28, from 71 samples.

parameter_audit.covariance: Fixed full-sample weights and normalization; local warm-start branch.
parameter_audit.extension: Every additional full-sample shared-two fit passing local checks is audited, regardless of its start. This targets parameter stability, not configuration selection.

bootstrap.null: Recenter on shared_one model; resample whole configurations; re-estimate covariance and refit shared_one and independent_one.
bootstrap.note: Finite-draw intervals do not quantify finite-sample calibration bias.
bootstrap.scope_note: The matched pair control is also calibrated to separate time-grid changes from the addition of source operators.

interpretation: Exploratory source compatibility and window diagnostics; no automatic plateau, model or final-potential selection.
